status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11. Fayette County's FY2026 budget says QTS is building a new data center on a 600+ acre parcel in Fayetteville, with construction started in March 2023 and estimated completion in February 2027. City and county records also confirm construction notices, driveway/traffic-signal work, water-accounting activity, and water-line easements. The reviewed records do not establish a published MW capacity, certificate of occupancy, energization, partial live service, or full buildout.

history.value: Government notices confirm active construction-related work and county water-accounting activity. A City of Fayetteville page reports a site-plan presentation denial and later withdrawn appeal; the reviewed records do not establish that every campus phase has final site-plan, building-permit, certificate-of-occupancy, utility, or energization approval.
